title: Serving tracing tests: set MLFLOW_EXPERIMENT_ID via monkeypatch and assert mock calls
answers: How to write serving tracing tests in test_provider.py
Mocking experiment id in serving tracing tests
Test convention for UC trace location serving regression tests
body:
Convention: serving-mode tests in tests/tracing/test_provider.py set the experiment id with monkeypatch.setenv('MLFLOW_EXPERIMENT_ID', '123') and take the mock_databricks_serving_with_tracing_env fixture plus monkeypatch as arguments.
Do not patch mlflow.tracking.fluent._get_experiment_id for these tests. The serving branch no longer calls it, so such a patch hides the real code path.
Capture the mocks that matter (for example mock.patch on get_tracking_uri or _get_store) and assert their calls explicitly, e.g. mock_store_fn.assert_called_once_with('databricks') and get_experiment.assert_called_once_with('123'). Reviewers asked for these assertions.
A regression test that makes _get_experiment_id raise (side_effect=MlflowException) and asserts assert_not_called() guards the serving bypass.
applies: Tests for serving-mode tracing behaviour in tests/tracing/test_provider.py.
says: Add automated test coverage ensuring model serving traces bypass local experiment lookups.
Verify with regression tests that model serving trace destination checks target catalog storage.
Model serving trace tests must verify calls to the remote tracking store succeed.
Model serving endpoints fail when attempting to validate experiments against local storage.
search: In tests/tracing/test_provider.py, serving-mode tracing tests must set the experiment id using monkeypatch.setenv('MLFLOW_EXPERIMENT_ID', '123') with the mock_databricks_serving_with_tracing_env fixture instead of patching mlflow.tracking.fluent._get_experiment_id. Tests should explicitly assert mock calls on functions like get_tracking_uri, mock_store_fn.assert_called_once_with('databricks'), and get_experiment.assert_called_once_with('123'). A regression test making _get_experiment_id raise an MlflowException guards the serving bypass.
